title: Mystical Equation Table
description: A surreal scene shows a wooden table covered in scattered papers and parchments filled with complex mathematical equations and symbols. Three disembodied hands in different colors interact with the items: a blue hand holds a geometric shape at the top left, a purple hand writes with a quill at the bottom, and a golden hand holds a coin over a paper on the right. At the center sits a glowing glass orb containing a black rose, illuminated by a dramatic beam of light from above against a dark, starry background with floating scrolls and tablets.
